declared.title: The temporal relationship between non-acceptance of positive and negative emotions and psychological symptoms in refugees
declared.foundIn: agent contre-preuve, recherche Crossref / Europe PMC du 2026-11-22 (reports/feeling-bad-about-feeling-bad/counter-evidence.md) ; titre relevé sur Crossref par l'agent : contrôle d'identité plus faible

population: 1,235 refugees in transit in Indonesia; survey in Arabic, Farsi, Dari, Somali or English (share of Arabic speakers not given)

findings.text: Not accepting one's negative emotions goes with PTSD symptoms in both directions over time, and no link with depression is reported

support.sentence: Non-acceptance of negative emotions showed a bidirectional relationship with PTSD symptoms.

limits: brief measure of non-acceptance of negative emotions
the only sample found that includes Arabic speakers
